checks.label: Integration is the inverse of differentiation: every answer rule on these screens, differentiated by working out its slope from the rule at points right across, gives back the rate it was integrated from, with or without a number added

To find the antiderivative, do the opposite things in the opposite order: first add one to the power, then divide by the power; for every power from none up to the fourth the answer differentiates back to that power, and dividing by the old power instead does not
We cannot set n = −1 in the fraction 1/(n + 1): the reverse rule gives no answer for the power −1, where the new power is 0, and gives one for every other whole power from −3 to 4

The + c appears because when you differentiate a constant term, the answer is zero: at every setting of the slider for c, the tangent drawn on the family keeps the same slope while its height moves by c, every lift arrow is c long, and each member has the same slope as the one with no c at every point across

Determines the constant of integration from given conditions: on each screen with a known value, the c found from it puts the curve through that value, a value at a later moment of the capacitor gives the same c, and with that c the capacitor curve drawn passes through its known value

Determining and using a function from a given rate of change and initial conditions: each puzzle that gives a rate and a known value accepts only the curve found from both, and reads its answer off that curve
Every tangent drawn, on every screen and after every answer, has the slope its rule gives at its point and passes through that point on the curve

From the rules, by hand: x³ has slope 3 at 1; 2x² 4, a plain 2 0 and x² 2 at 1; x³ ÷ 3 has slope 4 at 2; x⁴ ÷ 4 1, x⁴ ÷ 3 4 ÷ 3 and 3x² 6 at 1; 6x² + 4x + 5 integrates to 2x³ + 2x² + 5x with slope 15 at 1; 4x³ − 6x + 2 is 0 at 1, and 12x² − 6 and 4x⁴ − 6x² + 2x have slopes 24 and 6 there; x² + c has slope 4 at 2 and height 9 at c = 5; the capacitor holds 11 C at 4 s with c = 3, 8 C without; the boat is 19 m out at 3 s, 9 m without c, 16 m from 2t; c = 5 for 6x² − 4x through 5 at 1, slope 10 for 6x³ − 4x² + 3; 3t² from 2 C at 1 s gives 9 C at 2 s, 10 C taking 2 as c, 8 C without; and the screens’ words quote these values
Every puzzle offers three different answers and accepts only the right one; each wrong answer is the slip it stands for

Before Check no puzzle gives its verdict: nothing red and the working ends in a question mark; a picked answer only draws its own rule; a right answer shows its fit with nothing red; every wrong answer shows its slip in red
Every demonstration has finished arriving within 5 s of its screen opening, and every pick’s or answer’s motion within 1.3 s
